technique_name: Describe how natural language processing is used in healthcare.
description: Natural language processing (NLP) is used in healthcare to process and analyze large amounts of unstructured textual data, such as medical records and patient notes. NLP technologies can be used to extract important information from this data, such as patient demographics, diagnoses, treatments, and medications.
